entry.title: Hello World from Goma - My First Blog Post
entry.content:
Hello from Goma!

My name is Elichama. I'm writing my first blog post from Goma / Butembo, DR Congo.

For a long time, I wanted to have my own website. Today, I made it! This blog was built with Cecil and PHP.

Why this blog?

I want to share:

  • What I learn in coding (PHP, Web Development)
  • Life in Goma and Butembo
  • Practical English and tech tips

This is just the beginning. I will post every week.

Thank you for reading my first post!

Elichama

"Small steps every day."
